ننتدب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَدِبُ (nantadibu) /nan.ta.di.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# نُنْتَدَبُ (nuntadabu) /nun.ta.da.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# نَنْتَدِبَ (nantadiba) /nan.ta.di.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# نُنْتَدَبَ (nuntadaba) /nun.ta.da.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
